name: coder
description: Coder keeps a project's .coder/ design and diagnosis documents honest: list reports illegal, missing, and malformed documents, checks diagnosis-code scopes, and verifies the lock hash; lock/unlock manage the lock; update replaces documents through the review flow; render turns them into a design.html page with Mermaid diagrams.
